title: Version 1.69.0
html:
Version 1.69.0 (Random Features Update!)

October 25th, 2024

Added:

  • A new conveyor has been introduced, the Extending Conveyor! This conveyor is a toggleable conveyor that extends outwards, this means you can use it to create some awesome contraptions.
  • Alongside the Extending Conveyor, a major revamp has been made for the Filter Conveyor. You are now able to select multiple items to filter at once, and indidually pick out their properties to be filtered. We're still working on moving this system over to lasers, so stay tuned for that!
  • We've decided that some fun changes need to be introduced for this update, so we added the Sparks Emitter! This is a fillable structure that emits sparks. Maybe you want to create a broken dashboard, or have some sparking electrical panels. You can find it at Illumine Designs!
  • Ever wanted to display some of those awesome items you have? Well now you can with the Pedestal! This structure that can be found at Illumine Designs will levitate and rotate an item for displaying.
  • A new base preset is here for 99 Robux, the 15 Stud Challenge Preset. This preset starts you out with 15 studs of land, something that isn't normally possible. You might be asking, why? Why not! Challenge yourself: try not to expand your land and progress through the game. Good luck!

Changes:

  • Our data systems have been migrated from ProfileService to ProfileStore. This doesn't really mean anything to an average player, but we thought that it should be mentioned! This should have some improvements with loading in your slots.
  • The UI for property selection has been changed to fit our new style! This is an ongoing effort and you may see some other UI change in the future! We hope you like it!
  • The Lunar tools have temporarily had their antigravity effects removed due to the crazy bugs it created. We're still evaluating if it is worthwhile to maintain this feature!

📊 Material Value Changes!?

  • Some material values have been adjusted for progression purposes. We've been listening, and we agree that Flameslate and Magmite were too weakened. As a result, Magmite has been buffed (240 -> 360) (296 -> 444) (Refined, Forged), and Flameslate has been buffed (72 -> 108) (84 -> 126). We've noticed Lumite has been way too easy to obtain, so the value of that has been lowered (195 -> 165) (304 -> 270). All values here are for volume!

Notes:

  • The Grabbiest Grabber Plushie campaign has ended! Our partnership with Lootbloc has been wonderful, and we are happy to announce that we made 250 sales for the plushie. It's such an honor being able to create awesome content for you, the community! 🥰
  • Thanks for reading! We're winding down on major updates as we begin to progress towards the Christmas / Winter update coming this December! Stay tuned for more information on that 👀

Version 1.69.1

October 25th, 2024

Changed:

  • Anchored objects can no longer be unboxed / placed

Fixed:

  • Fixed the pedestal not removing it's object correctly

Version 1.69.2

October 26th, 2024

Changed:
